run_dcgan_training: run the DCGAN training script with configurable dataset, batch size, and epochs via argparse CLI
train_generator_discriminator: train a generator and discriminator network using adversarial loss with Adam optimizer and mixed precision
calculate_fid_metric: calculate the Fréchet Inception Distance metric between real and generated images using InceptionV3
initialize_dcgan_weights: initialize generator and discriminator Conv and BatchNorm layer weights with normal distribution
push_dcgan_to_hub: push the trained DCGAN generator model to the HuggingFace hub with an organization name
